title: BoJ Summary of Opinions — January 21-22, 2027 MPM (Outlook Report meeting)
source: EST: boj.or.jp/en/mopo/mpmsche_minu/ ('Monetary Policy Meetings'), fetched raw direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 41,959 bytes) and parsed row-by-row out of its two year tables by this session, independently of the sweep that seeded boj-summary-of-opinions-2027-03-29. Against the header 'Date of MPM || Outlook Report (The Bank's View) | Summary of Opinions | MPM Minutes', the 2027 table's FIRST row parses exactly as ['Jan. 21 (Thurs.), 22 (Fri.)', 'Jan. 22 (Fri.)', 'Feb. 1 (Mon.)', 'Mar. 24 (Wed.)'] — i.e. the Summary of Opinions for the January 2027 MPM publishes 2027-02-01, that meeting DOES carry an Outlook Report (unlike the March and June 2027 meetings, whose Outlook cells read '-'), and the full Minutes follow 2027-03-24. The 2026 table's matching row ['Jan. 22 (Thurs.), 23 (Fri.)', 'Jan. 23 (Fri.)', 'Feb. 2 (Mon.)', 'Mar. 25 (Wed.)'] shows the same 10-day decision-to-Summary lag on the previous January, published with PDF byte sizes, i.e. already realised. Filed estimate on two counts, identical to the six BoJ entries already on this calendar: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has FED: for the Federal Reserve and no slot for the Bank of Japan, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Release time is not read off this page and is not asserted here
notes: DISCOVERED during the japan-cpi-tokyo-flash-2027-01-29 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05), three days after that Tokyo flash and inside its +/-5-day corridor. The calendar already tracks this document class for the March 2027 meeting (boj-summary-of-opinions-2027-03-29) and tracks the January decision itself (boj-decision-2027-01-22), so the January Summary was a gap in an otherwise complete pair. THE SAME TRAP THE MARCH ENTRY NAMES APPLIES HERE AND IS THE REASON TO FILE IT: a Summary of Opinions records views expressed AT the meeting it names, so this document is written 2027-01-21/22 and contains NO reaction to the Tokyo January CPI flash that publishes 2027-01-29 (japan-cpi-tokyo-flash-2027-01-29, estimate) three days earlier on the tape. A reader on 2027-02-01 receives the board's own reasoning and the first post-meeting Japanese price print within three days of each other and will be tempted to read one as a response to the other; it cannot be. The first BoJ venue that actually holds the 2027-01-29 flash is the 2027-03-17/18 MPM (boj-decision-2027-03-18, estimate), 48 days after it. Impact is LOW: symbols is empty, no house playbook is rates- or FX-keyed, and the BoJ channel to this calendar's AI names runs through yen funding and global term premium, both second-order for a US equity book and both already owned by the FOMC ledgers. It carries slightly more than the March analogue for one reason worth recording: January 2027 IS an Outlook Report meeting (the March one is not), so this Summary is the individual-member commentary behind fresh staff projections, at the meeting Reuters' 2026-07-23 poll pointed at as the first of the year surveys expect to move toward 1.50%. Precedent for filing a central-bank meeting-account release as its own entry: boj-summary-of-opinions-2027-03-29, fomc-minutes-2026-12-30 and ecb-account-2026-10-08, all kind 'macro-print'. The same parse also shows the January MPM Minutes publishing 2027-03-24 — flagged here and deliberately NOT proposed, since the calendar tracks no BoJ minutes at all and 2027-03-24 is outside any honest reading of this corridor.
